summary: This informational RFC defines the disclosure link relation type, which points to a list of IPR disclosures made about the related material.

plainLanguage.summary: The disclosure link relation identifies a list of intellectual-property disclosures about a resource. This memo formally defines and registers that relation.

questions: how to link to patent disclosures
what does the disclosure link relation mean
subtitle: The disclosure relation points to IPR disclosures about a resource.

tldr.problem: The disclosure link relation was already used for patent disclosures but lacked a formal specification and registration.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC defines disclosure as a link to a list of IPR disclosures concerning the linked context resource.
tldr.outcome: IANA registered the disclosure relation in the Link Relations registry.

today: RFC 6579 is an Informational registration of the disclosure link relation. The unit metadata lists no update or replacement.

sections.title: A Link to IPR Disclosures
sections.content:
RFC 5988 defines a framework for typed links between web resources. This memo specifies the disclosure relation, which identifies a list of IPR disclosures concerning the material referenced by the link's context.

The RFC says “patent disclosure” is synonymous with “IPR disclosure” for this relation. It notes that the W3C already required the relation in its documents before the registration was formalized.
sections.plainLanguage: A disclosure link points readers to a list of intellectual-property disclosures about a document or other resource. The memo gives the relation a formal definition.

sections.title: How the Relation Is Used
sections.content:
When disclosure is used, the target IRI must represent a list of patent disclosures made with respect to the material identified by the context IRI. The list may be empty or contain one or more entries.

The RFC gives both an HTML anchor example and an HTTP Link header example. It distinguishes disclosure from copyright, which refers to a copyright statement.
sections.plainLanguage: The target of a disclosure link is the list of relevant patent disclosures. A page can provide that link in HTML or an HTTP header.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content:
The RFC says the disclosure relation introduces no new security issues beyond those associated with the general web-linking mechanism in RFC 5988.

IANA registered the disclosure relation in the Link Relations registry with a description and a reference to RFC 6579.
sections.plainLanguage: The link type adds no new security issue beyond ordinary web links. IANA records its meaning in the Link Relations registry.

references.text: Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, RFC 2119, March 1997.
